in_marathi.name: Pala
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pala हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Pala means 'protector' or 'guardian'. It is a revered title given to various Hindu deities and gods, symbolizing their role in shielding and safeguarding their devotees.
